نثنوني (form XII)
# نَثْنَوْنِي (naṯnawnī) /naθ.naw.niː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
# نَثْنَوْنِيَ (naṯnawniya) /naθ.naw.ni.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
